charts.missing_reason: no chart definitions in this site's evidence_base — a chart with no audited series must not be drawn

facts.missing_reason: no evidence_base facts — the register is the only place a charted figure may come from

section_eyebrow.llm_guidance: Short uppercase eyebrow, 2-4 words, e.g. 'Evidenced, not asserted'. Optional.

section_title.llm_guidance: Short heading for the chart section, under 10 words. Describe what the charts show WITHOUT stating any figure — the figures are rendered by the system from the site's evidence register and must never be written here.

section_intro.llm_guidance: One or two plain sentences introducing the charts. NEVER state, round, summarise or preview a number: every figure on this section is drawn by the system from an audited fact row, and a number written here is by definition unverified. Write about what is being measured and why it matters, not how big it is.
